channel.title: The Signal
channel.description: A finite daily briefing: the handful of developments that changed the picture today, with sources, momentum and running forecasts.

item.title: Sunday 18 October 2026
item.description:
France woke to the cost of its worst unrest in years, and Macron speaks tonight. Ukraine sent more than a thousand drones into Russia hours after Washington waived the sanctions meant to squeeze Moscow's oil money. Brent crude sits near $110 as the Saudi–Houthi war widens, and Ebola is spreading person to person in Kenya for the first time. Two votes are close: Alberta decides tomorrow whether to start down the road out of Canada, and Brazil picks a president next Sunday.

  • France counts the damage, and waits for Macron
  • Ukraine sends 1,000 drones into Russia as Washington waives sanctions
  • Oil nears $110 as the Saudi–Houthi war widens
  • Ebola is now spreading inside Kenya
  • Alberta votes tomorrow on starting the road out of Canada
  • Trump's approval hits a record low with 16 days to go
  • Brazil's runoff is a coin toss, one week out
  • Settlers attack European diplomats as Washington tells Israel to crack down
  • Pakistan and the Taliban keep trading fire on the border
